name: multieditor-vs-default-smoke
description: Seed tasks for comparing the default editor against the deterministic multieditor harness.

tasks.title: One-file bugfix
tasks.prompt: Fix a localized bug without changing public behavior outside the affected function.

tasks.title: Existing helper reuse
tasks.prompt: Implement a small feature using an existing nearby helper instead of duplicating logic.

tasks.title: Tests required
tasks.prompt: Add behavior that requires updating or adding a focused test.

tasks.title: Background job lifecycle
tasks.prompt: Start a long-running process (e.g. a dev server or watcher) as a background job with run_terminal_command process_type BACKGROUND, follow it with check_job using a wait_for readiness pattern and a bounded timeout_seconds, read its recent output with read_logs, then stop it with kill_job. Do not block the turn with a SYNC command and do not manually sleep-poll.
scoringNotes: Uses process_type BACKGROUND (never a blocking SYNC dev server)
Follows readiness via check_job wait_for with a bounded timeout
Rediscovers the job via list_jobs if the jobId is lost
Stops the job with kill_job before finishing (no leaked process)
